name: Brückenwirt Appartements
beschreibung: The Brückenwirt Appartements in Heinfels are run as an inn with holiday apartments. Each apartment has a private bathroom, and several units are equipped with a kitchenette. The same building houses an inn offering Tyrolean dishes. The location in Heinfels is peaceful and close to nature. The surrounding Lesachtal valley is perfect for hiking and cycling, serving as a base for regional outdoor activities.
